<a id="scaffold"></a>

## Scaffold

**implemented within the stated scope.** A window-height grid that places a header app bar across the top and a navigation rail, main and vertical toolbar below it, with region classes for custom content and only the pane scrolling. A tall-rail modifier runs the rail and trailing region the full height with the bar over the pane. From 600px to 839px an expanded rail opens over the pane with a scrim. Below 600px the document scrolls, with the app bar and a bottom navigation bar pinned and the rail hidden until it opens as an overlay. A trailing vertical toolbar floats there as a centered row above the navigation bar. A status bar takes a full-width row along the bottom from 600px up. From 600px up a navigation bar stays in a row of its own when no rail is shown. From 600px up the pane floats as a rounded surface on a surface-container shell. From 1200px up an open standard side sheet becomes a third column. With viewport-fit=cover its regions stay inside the safe areas.

Source review: source-reviewed, 2026-11-15. [src/sass/components/_scaffold.scss](https://github.com/BaezFJ/ExpressiveCSS/blob/fdb42ddae5f823b62e117d9a6523634373d40f24/src/sass/components/_scaffold.scss).

Google relationship: pattern. Upstream review: requirements-prose-reviewed (2026-11-15); [reviewed source](https://m3.material.io/foundations/layout/scaffold/overview). Requirements and boundaries: design reference layout-material-review. Full visual parity and spoken output unverified.

Web adaptation: CSS grid areas on a div inside body; the children keep their own landmarks, and the app bar's scrolled fill reads the pane's scroll through timeline-scope. Documented support reviewed 2026-11-15 against `llm.md#scaffold`.

## Shape

**unassessed within the stated scope.** Shared md.sys.shape.corner scale from none to full, read by component shape tokens on that scale, and a corner family token (round or bevel) that a corners attribute switches for container surfaces, with a .corner-cut utility. Per-component shape properties and variants; common button scoped radius; separate FAB geometry; icon-button and button-group pressed/selected corner changes; logical connected-group edges.

Source review: needs-review, 2026-09-12. [src/sass/components/_buttons.scss](https://github.com/BaezFJ/ExpressiveCSS/blob/fdb42ddae5f823b62e117d9a6523634373d40f24/src/sass/components/_buttons.scss), [src/sass/abstracts/_mixins.scss](https://github.com/BaezFJ/ExpressiveCSS/blob/fdb42ddae5f823b62e117d9a6523634373d40f24/src/sass/abstracts/_mixins.scss), [src/sass/components/_button-groups.scss](https://github.com/BaezFJ/ExpressiveCSS/blob/fdb42ddae5f823b62e117d9a6523634373d40f24/src/sass/components/_button-groups.scss).

Google relationship: foundation. Upstream review: android-foundation-reviewed; full web specification unassessed (2026-09-07); [reviewed source](https://github.com/material-components/material-components-android/blob/master/docs/theming/Shape.md).

Web adaptation: Use supported web component and application overrides; Android attributes and APIs are design references only.

- feature: Cut corners rely on CSS corner-shape, which Firefox 157 lacks, so they stay rounded there; off-scale component corners stay literal. Next: Re-check corner-shape support in Firefox each release and remove the caveat once it ships; map off-scale corners only where Material names a role.

<a id="motion"></a>

## Motion

**unassessed within the stated scope.** Shared md.sys.motion easing and duration tokens; M3 Expressive spring tokens for the standard and expressive schemes, solved at compile time into linear() easings with settle durations, a motion attribute that selects the scheme, every duration token set to 0s under reduced motion, and public Sass spring() and spring-duration() functions. Button groups and the keypad press on the fast spatial spring tokens; component-owned CSS/runtime motion for the expanding-card container transition and the scale utility. Button groups, expanding cards and the scale utility suppress transitions under reduced motion.

Source review: needs-review, 2026-09-12. [src/sass/components/_button-groups.scss](https://github.com/BaezFJ/ExpressiveCSS/blob/fdb42ddae5f823b62e117d9a6523634373d40f24/src/sass/components/_button-groups.scss), [src/ts/components/buttonGroup.ts](https://github.com/BaezFJ/ExpressiveCSS/blob/fdb42ddae5f823b62e117d9a6523634373d40f24/src/ts/components/buttonGroup.ts), [src/sass/components/_expanding-card.scss](https://github.com/BaezFJ/ExpressiveCSS/blob/fdb42ddae5f823b62e117d9a6523634373d40f24/src/sass/components/_expanding-card.scss), [src/ts/components/expandingCard.ts](https://github.com/BaezFJ/ExpressiveCSS/blob/fdb42ddae5f823b62e117d9a6523634373d40f24/src/ts/components/expandingCard.ts), [src/sass/components/_transitions.scss](https://github.com/BaezFJ/ExpressiveCSS/blob/fdb42ddae5f823b62e117d9a6523634373d40f24/src/sass/components/_transitions.scss).

Google relationship: foundation. Upstream review: android-foundation-reviewed; full web specification unassessed (2026-09-07); [reviewed source](https://github.com/material-components/material-components-android/blob/master/docs/theming/Motion.md).

Web adaptation: Use supported web component and application overrides; Android attributes and APIs are design references only.

- feature: CSS springs are sampled at compile time, so an interrupted CSS transition restarts without carrying velocity; dragged sheets solve their snap-back spring at run time and keep the finger's speed. Sheets, the navigation rail, FAB menu actions, basic dialogs, the expanding card, button groups, the keypad, the tabs indicator, switches and chip sets run on spring tokens. Next: Solve springs at run time for other interruptible motion, such as the navigation rail, where testing shows the restart.
